content:
A listener writes “I live in Georgia, and I wanted to reach out about an experience. While going through some old text messages with a friend, I came across a message I sent him on May 18, 2024, describing something that had apparently happened the previous morning at around 7:10 a.m. while I was at work.

I was outside working with my boss and one of my coworkers when the three of us began hearing some strange sounds. At the time, the only way I could describe them was as sounding like two different primates grunting back and forth at each other.

My boss heard the sounds as well and suggested that perhaps someone was playing a recording. The problem was that we weren’t close enough to any houses for that explanation to make much sense to me.

What stands out to me now, is how skeptical I was even at the time. There had to be some kind of explanation for what we had heard.

I want to be very clear that I’m not claiming we heard Sasquatch. I have no idea what we heard. There are plenty of animals in Georgia capable of making unusual sounds, and unfortunately, I don’t have a recording of the vocalizations.

There were three of us who heard the sounds, I specifically described them at the time as two primates grunting back and forth. I’ve also had a number of other unexplained experiences over the years, although I’m not necessarily suggesting that any of them are connected.

I grew up not believing in the paranormal. My first unusual experience happened when I was around 19 or 20 while I was working at my church in Connecticut. I saw what appeared to be part of a shadow figure and actually searched the building because I assumed one of the pastors had come in without me noticing.

After moving to Georgia, I worked as a custodian at an elementary school from January through June 2022 and had a series of unusual experiences there. These included unexplained voices, doors slamming, a tall figure crossing a dark gym without activating the motion-sensor lights, strange activity involving classroom lights, what appeared to be a mother and two children in the cafeteria, and a couple of incidents in which I felt something physically touch or pull at me.

I later worked at a wastewater treatment plant, where I had two other strange experiences involving unexplained lights.

On October 31, 2022, I saw two identical red lights approximately three or four feet off the ground and roughly a couple of feet apart. I initially assumed they were the lights of a dumpster truck we were expecting. When I started walking toward them, both lights blinked off simultaneously. There was nothing there, and the actual dumpster truck arrived a few minutes later.

Then, on July 31, 2023, I recorded an unexplained orange light near the entrance to the plant. I also have video from earlier that afternoon showing the area where the light later appeared, and there was no obvious light source visible in that location.

I’m not trying to connect all of these experiences or suggest that they have a common explanation. In particular, I don’t want to turn the sounds we heard in May 2024 into a Sasquatch encounter when I simply don’t know what caused them.

I just thought the vocalizations might be something you would be interested in hearing about, especially because two other people were present and heard them as well.”
